answer_text: H.No. 8, Sector 15, Chandigarh 26 August 2026 The Education Secretary, Chandigarh Subject: Eco-Clubs for rural schools to protect nature Sir/Madam As Club In-charge of our Ecology Club, I write as Vaibhav to urge action for schools in nearby villages. Young people must see that forests, clean air and biodiversity are shared duties, not optional lessons. Starting this work in childhood creates habits of care. Eco-Clubs would give rural students practical tasks: planting trees, keeping campuses clean, and spreading messages on waste and water. That training makes future guardians of the environment. The Department should grant money, materials and teacher support, and invite green NGOs to mentor the clubs so the effort is not left to one enthusiastic school alone. Yours faithfully Vaibhav
